findings: [29] «Исаии гл. V, ст. 7, 8» (Isaiah 5:7, 8): the quoted text is Isaiah 5:8 only; reference kept as printed.
[129] «Малоpu» is typed with Latin p and u for Cyrillic р and и (Малори, Malori); rendered 'Lucy Mallory' as at [119].

[134] «Амшаспанд-Брахман» (Amshaspand-Brakhman) twice: the Avesta's confession (Patet) names Amshaspand Bahman, guardian of cattle; 'Brahman' looks like an error in the source or its Russian intermediary. Translated as printed, 'Amshaspand-Brahman'.
[135] «Каорда Авеста» (Kaorda Avesta) for Khorda Avesta (Хорда Авеста); rendered 'Khorda Avesta'.

[167] «не затевать ссоры с ближним и не отвечать ему на его приветствие» ('not to start a quarrel with one's neighbor and not to answer his greeting'): the sense wants 'and to answer his greeting'; the second «не» ('not') looks like a slip. Translated as printed.
[176] The first number of day VIII is printed bold («**1**») and set as a text block, unlike every other number; day VIII also has no opening thought between its title and reading 1. Kept as printed.
[177] «Если адвокатуры, искусство и медицина» ('if the bars, art, and medicine'): plural «адвокатуры» for «адвокатура» (advokatura, 'the bar'), as in the three earlier mentions; translated 'the bar'.
[187] stray «**» after «10000 рублей,» (10,000 rubles): no footnote follows; omitted in the English.
[238] Reserve day X: the section number 3 is missing before this Talmud group (the numbering runs 1, 2, 4–9); translated as printed.

[304] The heading prints «ХІІа» with Cyrillic Х and Belarusian-Ukrainian І letters instead of Latin XII; rendered 'XIIa'. The section's thoughts (love of God, renouncing one's own will) have nothing to do with its title «ОДУРМАНЕНИЕ ПРИБАВЛЕНИЕ» (odurmanenie pribavlenie, 'stupefaction, supplement'); title translated as printed.

[316] Channing: «Идея свободы — в древних и новых религиях» ('the idea of freedom—in ancient and new religions'); Channing's sense (and the pairing with 'religious sects') suggests a slip for «республиках» (respublikakh, 'republics'); translated as printed.
[344] [345] Luke 17:7–8 is printed with final periods instead of question marks (the calendar text for 1 November has «?»); periods kept as printed.
[396] The sage's reply opens a quotation («Это прекрасный вопрос…) that is never closed; left unclosed as printed.

[425] Carlyle: «если справедливость остается годы и даже столетия не наказанной» ('if justice remains unpunished for years and even centuries'); the sense requires «несправедливость» (nespravedlivost', 'injustice'); translated as printed. The rhetorical question «неужели … вам всё еще напоминать…» also ends in a period, kept.
[461] Reserve day XIX: the section number 3 is missing before this Conway thought (the numbering runs 1, 2, 4, 5); translated as printed.
disposition: Retain the audited Russian source and SHA-256 unchanged. The English follows the printed reading (or its evident sense where marked) and the unit stays reviewed; Confirm against the printed volume 42 at the next print-witness pass.
